
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiao987334176/p/19637760" title="发布于 2026-02-27 09:16">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">docker安装zabbix7.4</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>一、概述</h1>
<p>随着Zabbix 7.0 LTS的正式发布，它将为企业提供提供比以往任何版本都更容易使用的具有各种开箱即用的企业级功能的一体化监控解决方案。</p>
<p>zabbix7.0新功能如下：</p>
<p>1.通过定义灵活的基于场景的多步骤监控网站和Web应用程序。<br>2.通过自动proxy负载均衡和高可用性功能，<br>按需扩展Zabbix环境并确保100%的可用性。<br>3.Zabbix proxy现在支持将所有采集的指标存储在内存中。<br>4.为了大幅提升指标轮询的速度和扩展性，<br>同步式poller进程已被异步式poller取代。<br>5.集中控制数据采集超时可以更好地处理较长数据采集时间间隔的指标和自定义检查。<br>6.引入了多种新的仪表板小部件，使您能够更全面地了解您监控的指标和基础架构。<br>7.网络自动发现支持并行检查，将主机和服务发现的速度提高了10到100倍。<br>8.开箱即用的多因子认证（MFA）支持提供了企业级安全性，<br>并为配置用户认证方法提供了更大的灵活性。<br>9.更灵活的资源发现和管理<br>10.Zabbix 7.0 LTS预装了许多最受欢迎的供应商和云提供商的新模板</p>
<p>详细内容请参阅官方文档：<br><a href="https://www.zabbix.com/rn/rn7.0.0" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.zabbix.com/rn/rn7.0.0</a><br><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202602/1341090-20260225164559237-579727339.png" alt="0aa216340442cf4dd9de10708a106eca" width="790" height="444" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1>二、安装</h1>
<p>使用一台Linux服务器，提前安装了docker，docker-compose即可，<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>注意：docker版本不要太老了，最好使用新版。</strong></span></p>
<p>这里服务器ip为：192.168.52.130</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>创建持久化目录</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">mkdir</span> -p /opt/zabbix/{mysql,alertscripts,externalscripts,export,modules,enc,ssh_keys,ssl/certs,ssl/keys,ssl/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ssl_ca,snmptraps}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">chmod</span> -R <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">755</span> /opt/zabbix</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div>修改docker-compose.yml，为Agent分配固定IP，避免重启后变化：</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cat</span> &gt; /opt/zabbix/docker-compose.yml &lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">EOF</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
version: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">3.8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

services:
  mysql</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server:
    image: mysql:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    container_name: zabbix</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mysql
    restart: always
    command:
      </span>- --character-set-server=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">utf8mb4
      </span>- --collation-server=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">utf8mb4_bin
      </span>- --default-authentication-plugin=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mysql_native_password
      </span>- --log-bin-trust-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span>-creators=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: zabbix_root_pwd
      MYSQL_DATABASE: zabbix
      MYSQL_USER: zabbix
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: zabbix_pwd
    volumes:
      </span>- /opt/zabbix/mysql:/var/lib/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mysql
    networks:
      zabbix</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">net:
        ipv4_address: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">172.20</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

  zabbix</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server:
    image: zabbix</span>/zabbix-server-mysql:alpine-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7.4</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">latest
    container_name: zabbix</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
    restart: always
    ports:
      </span>- <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">10051:10051</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    environment:
      DB_SERVER_HOST: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">172.20</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      MYSQL_DATABASE: zabbix
      MYSQL_USER: zabbix
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: zabbix_pwd
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: zabbix_root_pwd
      ZBX_CACHESIZE: 512M
      ZBX_HISTORYCACHESIZE: 256M
      ZBX_TRENDCACHESIZE: 128M
      ZBX_VALUECACHESIZE: 256M
      # Zabbix </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.4新增进程配置
      ZBX_STARTCONNECTORS: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      ZBX_STARTJAVAPOLLERS: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      ZBX_JAVAGATEWAY_ENABLE: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      ZBX_JAVAGATEWAY: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">172.20</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      ZBX_STARTREPORTWRITERS: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>启动服务</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>docker-compose up -d</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div>等等几分钟，查看服务状态是否正常</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div>获取Agent容器IP</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>docker-compose exec zabbix-agent <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">hostname</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i
输出：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">172.20</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.5</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div>登录web页面</div>
<div>http://192.168.52.130:8080/</div>
<div>默认用户名：Admin，密码：zabbix</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202602/1341090-20260225172522207-1320422358.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>

<div>点击数据采集--&gt;主机--&gt;Zabbix server，将agent ip 127.0.0.1修改为172.20.0.5，最后点击更新</div>
<div>注意：这里必须使用ip地址，不能使用别名或者域名。</div>
